subject: ALIGNED clause
notes: 'An ALIGNED clause specified for a multiple-occurrence data item applies to each occurrence of that item.' The per-occurrence STRIDE therefore rounds up to a byte while the WIDTH stays the declared bit count; the two were one number at every subscript site (ReferenceResolver, CallBinder, InitializeBinder, OdoModel, GroupValueSlicer) and are now split by BitLayout.StrideBits. RunBits counts stride x (n-1) + width, never stride x n, because 8.5.1.6.3 generates trailing filler only 'to advance alignment ... for the NEXT item'. Golden derivation: 05 T PIC 1(4) BIT OCCURS 3 ALIGNED. places occurrences at bits 0, 8, 16 for an extent of 20 padded to 24, so FUNCTION LENGTH is 3 where without ALIGNED it is 2 - measured 3, with each occurrence read back at its own value.
